dict.string: Patch Pilot watches plug-in preset folders in Documents (FabFilter, Valhalla, Xfer and others) to keep them in sync with your other machines.
Patch Pilot reads your Ableton User Library in Music to keep templates and presets in sync with your other machines.
Patch Pilot looks for duplicate presets on your Desktop when you ask it to.
Patch Pilot looks for plug-in installers in Downloads for your Installer Vault.
Patch Pilot can keep your Installer Vault or backup on an external drive.
Patch Pilot can keep your Installer Vault or backup on a network drive.
Patch Pilot finds your other linked machines on this network and copies synced files straight between them, encrypted.
